name: City Council Regular Meeting
agenda_text:
RAY PEARL  NED E DAVIS  KELLY HONIG  SUSAN McSWEENEY  BRAD HALPERN
  Mayor  Mayor Pro Tem  Councilmember  Councilmember  Councilmember

  AGENDA
  Regular Meeting of the City Council
  CITY OF WESTLAKE VILLAGE
  City Council Chambers
  31200 Oak Crest Drive
  Westlake Village, CA 91361

  WEDNESDAY, JULY 26, 2023 - 6:30 p.m.
  .
  PUBLIC PARTICIPATION OPTIONS:
 This meeting will be conducted in a hybrid model. Members of the public may join this meeting
 virtually or attend in-person in the Council Chambers.

 Written comments may be emailed to the City Clerk's Office at antoinette@wlv.org no later than
 12:00 p.m. on the meeting date. Written comments will be provided to City Council prior to the
 meeting and posted at https://www.wlv.org/569/City-Council-Supplemental-Packets

  Please click the link below to join the webinar:
  https://us02web.zoom.us/j/83993246278
  Webinar ID: 839 9324 6278

  One Tap Mobile:
  +16694449171,,83993246278# OR +16699009128,,83993246278#
  Telephone:
  +1 669 444 9171 or +1 669 900 9128 or +1 346 248 7799

 Virtual participants will be muted until recognized at the appropriate time by the Mayor or
 the meeting chairperson. The meeting host will announce when individuals wishing to
 speak must “raise their hand”, at which time they will be unmuted.

 In accordance with the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990, if you require a disability-related
 modification or accommodation to attend or participate in this meeting, including auxiliary aids or
 services, please call the City Clerk’s office at (818) 706-1613 at least 48 hours prior to the meeting.

 Any disclosable public records related to an open session item on a regular meeting agenda and
 distributed by the City to the City Council less than 72 hours prior to that meeting are available for
 public inspection at City Hall (31200 Oak Crest Drive, Westlake Village) during normal business
 hours and are posted on the City’s Website - https://www.wlv.org/569/City-Council-Supplemental-
 Packets.
 CALL TO ORDER: 6:30 p.m.

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE:

ROLL CALL:  Councilmembers Halpern, McSweeney, Honig, Mayor Pro
  Tem Davis, Mayor Pearl

APPROVAL OF AGENDA:

APPROVAL OF MINUTES:

Minutes of the June 28, 2023 City Council Regular Meeting, July 12, 2023 City Council
Study Session and July 12, 2023 City Council Regular Meeting.

SPECIAL PRESENTATIONS/CEREMONIAL MATTERS:

1.  Business of the Quarter – Quarterly Business Recognition – 2nd Quarter 2023
  - Bonibi Coffee

2.  2023 Westlake Village Citizen and Youth of the Year Recognition
  • Dr. Ted Corwin – 2023 Citizen of the Year
  • Shai Adams – 2023 Youth of the Year

PUBLIC COMMENTS: Members of the public may address the City Council on items not on the printed
agenda. Please observe the time limit of three minutes. Members of the public may offer comment
telephonically or otherwise electronically by using Zoom teleconference service options as listed on Page 1
of this agenda. When attending in-person, complete a Speaker Card and submit it to the City Clerk prior to
the meeting starting.

COUNCIL RESPONSE:

STAFF COMMENTS:

COUNCIL COMMENTS:

MONTHLY DEPARTMENTAL REPORTS:

1.  Sheriff's Department Report

2.  Fire Department Report

3.  Chamber of Commerce Report

4.  Library Report

CITY COUNCIL COMMITTEE REPORTS: None
 PUBLIC HEARINGS:

1.  PUBLIC HEARING REGARDING ORDINANCE NO. 304-23 PERTAINING TO
  ELECTION SIGNS. ORDINANCE TITLE: AN ORDINANCE OF THE CITY OF
  WESTLAKE VILLAGE AMENDING THE WESTLAKE VILLAGE MUNICIPAL
  CODE TO UPDATE SIGN REGULATIONS AND APPROVING A CEQA
  EXEMPTION DETERMINATION - Waive the full reading and introduce Ordinance
  No. 304-23

  ORDINANCE NO. 304-23 - AN ORDINANCE OF THE CITY OF WESTLAKE VILLAGE AMENDING
  THE WESTLAKE VILLAGE MUNICIPAL CODE TO UPDATE SIGN REGULATIONS AND
  APPROVING A CEQA EXEMPTION DETERMINATION

MONTHLY IN-HOUSE DEPARTMENTAL REPORTS:

1.  Engineering Department Report

2.  Planning Department Report

3.  Cultural Recreation Report

CONSENT CALENDAR: Matters listed under the Consent Calendar are considered to be routine and
will be enacted by one motion and one vote. Unless otherwise requested by a Councilmember, there will be
no separate discussion of these items. If discussion is desired, that item will be removed from the Consent
Calendar and will be considered separately.

  APPROVAL OF WARRANTS: Warrants effective July 15, 2023 in the amount of
  $236,208.58

  GENERAL BUSINESS:

  1. REDESIGNATION OF LEAGUE OF CALIFORNIA CITIES VOTING
  DELEGATE FOR ANNUAL CONFERENCE - Designate Mayor Pro Tem
  Ned Davis as Voting Delegate for the 2023 League of California Cities
  Annual Conference.

  2. AGREEMENT WITH TOTAL BARRICADE SERVICE INCORPORATED
  FOR SPEED TRAILER DEPLOYMENT - Approve a professional services
  agreement with Total Barricade Service, Inc. for weekly speed trailer
  deployment services and authorize the Mayor to sign and execute the
  agreement on behalf of the City.

OLD BUSINESS:

1.  STATUS UPDATE ON CALENDAR YEAR 2023 CITY COUNCIL GOALS - City
  Council note and file the report.

2.  ADOPTION OF THE SIDEWALK MASTER PLAN FINAL REPORT – Adopt the
  Sidewalk Master Plan final report as presented.
 3.  CONSIDERATION OF ADOPTION OF COMMUNITY PARK PICKLEBALL
  COURTS PROJECT PLANS AND SPECIFICATIONS AND AUTHORIZATION TO
  ADVERTISE BIDS - Adopt the plans and specifications for the Community Park
  Pickleball Courts and authorize staff to advertise bids for the construction of the
  Community Park Pickleball Courts.

NEW BUSINESS: None

ADJOURNMENT:

This agenda was posted on Thursday, July 20, 2023 at 6:30 p.m. on the City’s website and in the
Posting Board at City Hall.

 Agenda and Staff Reports are posted on the City’s Website- Click on Public Meeting Agendas or
 www.wlv.org/agendacenter

 Signup for Agenda Posting Notifications for the new Agenda Center. The Agenda Center is a central
 location for all public meeting agendas. You select the categories for your notifications. Sign up using

 If any additional disclosable public records are distributed to City Council less than 72 hours prior to the
 meeting, such materials are available in City Hall during normal business hours and are posted on the
 City’s Website - https://www.wlv.org/569/City-Council-Supplemental-Packets

 Watch the City Council Meeting Video LIVE or to rewatch a prior meeting video, click “City Council
 Agendas, Minutes & Video” (http://westlakevillage.granicus.com/viewpublisher.php?view_id=8) City
 Council meetings can be seen live on WVTV Channel 10 or via web streaming on www.wlv.org
